questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file. My class MyMod_Carrier inherits vanilla PlateCarrierVest and should hold six items in its own cargo. Does the vanilla plate carrier have cargo of its own, and what line do I add to my class?
must_include: re:\bno\b|does not|doesn't|has none|none of its own|pouch
questions.verified: P:/DZ/characters/vests/config.cpp:24 to :55 (PlateCarrierVest has no itemsCargoSize; storage comes from the VestPouch attachment) and P:/DZ/gear/containers/config.cpp:646 and :658 (PlateCarrierPouches itemsCargoSize[]={5,3})
